description: This file defines functions to create, manage, and populate USP (User Services Platform) message objects representing error responses. It includes functions to create error messages, add parameter errors, and calculate outer error codes, primarily used in error handling within the USP messaging framework.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ERROR_RESP_CreateSingle(char * msg_id,int err_code,Usp__Msg * src_msg)
methods.description: Creates a simple USP error response message containing a single error, freeing the source message if provided.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ERROR_RESP_Create(char * msg_id,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Constructs a USP error message with specified message ID, error code, and error message.

methods.name: Usp__Error__ParamError * ERROR_RESP_AddParamError(Usp__Msg * resp,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a parameter-specific error to an existing error message object, dynamically reallocating the param_errors array.

methods.name: int ERROR_RESP_CalcOuterErrCode(int err)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate outer error code based on a given inner error code, especially in the context of Set, Add, or Delete messages.
